# Issue #150 — F1/F2 protocol revision

Revised only `benchmark/protocol.md`; final protocol checkpoint: `165f1c283e27115bdae5e6e9ed6ecc9ffe3791b6`.
Both exported review reports were downloaded and read: [146](exports/reports/146.json), [147](exports/reports/147.json).
F1: [tasks lines 28–42](../benchmark/protocol.md#tasks) freezes independent required-claim inventories, assertion accounting, separate dimension outcomes and fixed denominators, including omissions, extras, duplicates and contradictions.
F1: [baseline lines 84–86](../benchmark/protocol.md#baseline) pins those rules for both arms; [challenges lines 100–102](../benchmark/protocol.md#challenges) adds omission, extra-false-claim and duplicate/contradiction fixture designs.
F2: [tasks lines 38–39](../benchmark/protocol.md#tasks) defines independent fixed probes, raw request/output records, native-reference alignment and explicit missing/unsupported/error handling that cannot pass.
F2: [baseline lines 85–86](../benchmark/protocol.md#baseline) requires separate probe sessions and complete ledgers; [challenges lines 103–104](../benchmark/protocol.md#challenges) exercises constant, empty, truncated, unsupported and failed probe outputs.
Unresolved for both findings: executable scoring, independently checked native inventories/keys, implemented fixtures and substantive challenge execution require subsequent authorized work and independent review.
`git diff --check` and `python3 -I policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` exited 0 after the final protocol edit.
The evaluator reports errors=[], evidence_references=8, benchmark_executed=false, benchmark_ready=false and tool_quality=null; tasks/oracle/split/baseline/challenges remain missing.
`benchmark/preparation.json` does not pin the protocol, so no hash update was needed. The resources table was unchanged.
No quality threshold, version fallback, scope reduction or readiness claim was introduced; missing coverage and unmeasured quality remain explicit.

## What next
Policymaker: order independent F1/F2 re-review at the checkpoint above, then continue authorized preparation. Reuse the exported reviews and revised protocol; avoid repeating source scans or treating index verification as measured quality.

Waiting for the owner: request #151.
